Messages.Author: Woody Carey
Messages.Body:
I have a question for Tom:

Muaziz's ability states: "Blood Hunts cannot be called against Muaziz.
Muaziz gets +1 stealth on each of her actions."

Does this mean BOTH the Blood Hunt card which allows people to attack
her and Blood Hunt votes after diablerie, or does it mean one and not the
other?

For those of you wanting her spoiler:

Muaziz, Archon of Ulugh Beg
<Tremere>
GENERATION: 7
fortitude, auspex, dominate, THAUMATURGY
(Her special ability is as quoted above)

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Woody Carey <wca...@gladstone.uoregon.edu> wrote:
>Muaziz's ability states: "Blood Hunts cannot be called against Muaziz.
>Muaziz gets +1 stealth on each of her actions."
>
>Does this mean BOTH the Blood Hunt card which allows people to attack
>her and Blood Hunt votes after diablerie, or does it mean one and not the
>other?

Only votes are "called". The Blood Hunt card is not "called", so her ability
does not apply.
